speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, how old was the baby at birth, and are they currently feeding well?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice. The clinical picture of a 2-week-old, exclusively breastfed infant with weight gain and no signs of dehydration is consistent with this benign condition.
